prompts.name: natural_prompt_a
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: original transparent game sprite atlas for an existing illustrated pixel office. Edit the attached 4 rows by 4 columns staff atlas, preserving exactly the four people's identity, colors, costume, hair, accessories and detailed pixel illustration. Replace the crouched compact leg anatomy with natural adult seated anatomy: pelvis supported on an imaginary seat, thighs extending toward the desk, knees bent about 90 degrees below hip level, relaxed vertical shins, two shoes flat on the same floor. Never draw the chair, stool, desk, floor, background or text. Transparent RGBA. Each person in each row must keep exactly the same rear-three-quarter camera orientation looking upper-left toward the desk in ALL FOUR COLUMNS. No rotating from left to right across columns. Same head, torso, hip, knee and shoe coordinates in all four columns; only subtle arm/head differences. Column1 relaxed hands forward at keyboard height, column2 hands forward working at keyboard, column3 one hand near chin thinking but without turning body, column4 small notebook held low in front while reviewing, without turning body. Hips, knees, legs, feet completely identical across these four poses. No arms behind head, no dramatic stretch, no overhead arms. Seated silhouette should have roughly 60-66% from head to hip and 34-40% from hip to shoes, not the existing 80%/20% squat proportions. Legs anatomically proportional, moderate shoulder width, no chibi body, no elongated dragged foot, no isolated detached hand or shoe. Crisp restrained pixel clusters, dark clean outline, warm lighting matching the original. Maintain clean 4x4 grid with ample fully transparent gaps and all 16 complete figures inside cells. Rows: Sarah navy blazer brown bob; Aris white coat dark hair silver temples glasses; Elena olive waistcoat ivory blouse auburn bun glasses; Marcus purple hoodie dark tousled hair.

prompts.name: natural_fresh_prompt_a
prompts.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL transparent RGBA pixel-art sprite atlas, exactly 4 rows x 4 columns, 16 complete separate seated adult people, no labels, text, furniture, chairs, shadows, backgrounds or floor. Anatomically natural adults sitting at a desk that is not drawn. CRITICAL: long relaxed vertical lower legs, knees around hip level, thighs horizontal/foreshortened extending forward away from camera, feet flat below knees. Do NOT draw a squat, crouched body with knees folded into the torso. Show both shoes, not one stretched shoe. Head-to-hip takes about 65% of seated height, hip-to-shoe 35%. Camera is fixed orthographic rear three-quarter view facing UPPER LEFT: we see back and a little LEFT cheek, never changing camera between columns. Same pelvis, legs, shoes, head size and silhouette position for all four poses of each person. Each row is one person. Column1 relaxed hands low in front on keyboard, column2 subtle typing hands in same area, column3 hand thoughtfully on chin, column4 notebook held LOW in front while reading. Only arms change. Use refined hand-painted PIXEL ART with crisp clustered colors and readable small game sprites, warm amber light, dark defined contour, no glossy cartoon outlines or smooth vector rendering. Not photorealistic, not chibi. Keep complete sprites inside equal grid cells separated by at least 20 transparent pixels. Seated adult proportions including long shins are more important than dense clothing texture. Row1 Sarah: fair skin #E2C8B6, chestnut bob #6B4A3A, navy blazer #1E3A8A, ivory shirt, brown shoes. Row2 Aris: medium skin #B69077, short charcoal hair with silver temples, round metal spectacles, ivory white research coat #F8FAFC over teal shirt #0F766E, grey trousers, brown shoes. Row3 Elena: warm skin #D2A785, auburn bun #92400E, glasses, olive green vest #3F6212 over cream blouse, charcoal trousers, brown shoes. Row4 Marcus: warm skin #BC8C70, wavy near-black hair #1F2937, purple hoodie #7C3AED, navy trousers, sneakers.

prompts.name: chair_prompt_a
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for a cozy cutaway studio.
Primary request: each adult character is generated TOGETHER WITH their complete chair as one integrated seated figure. Make anatomically convincing office seating: hips supported on cushion, thighs approximately horizontal, knees bent naturally, normal short lower legs and planted shoes. No floating people, long hanging shins, impossible knees, detached chairs.
Layout: exactly FOUR rows and FOUR columns, equal square cells, one complete person+chair ensemble per cell. Transparent margins between cells, no labels, no scenery, no desks, no keyboard, no shadows outside the cell. All ensembles fully visible from hair to chair feet. Camera fixed behind the person, looking towards their workstation, rear three-quarter view with only a little of their left cheek visible, seated-facing-away. Low-detail crisp hand-painted pixel art, carefully chosen pixel clusters, warm amber edge light, rich cloth folds and chair stitching. No smooth vector art or photorealism.
Columns in EVERY row: 1 relaxed neutral at desk, 2 same person typing with forearms lightly raised, 3 same person thinking with one small hand gesture near cheek, 4 same person reading with slight head tilt. Keep camera, chair, legs, shoes, head size, body proportion, and character scale IDENTICAL across the four frames; only forearms and head may subtly change. Chair feet and casters ALWAYS touch the exact same ground baseline. Upper body gently leaning toward the desk. Both hands in FRONT of the body, arms never held overhead. The rear chair back partially obscures the person's LOWER back in office chairs. No exaggerated cartoon stretch, no backwards-facing typing, no extra fingers or limbs. Actual alpha transparency.
Row 1: Sarah, brown bob haircut, navy blazer with pale-blue shirt, beige trousers, black low shoes, seated in a compact brown-black upholstered swivel chair with armrests and five caster base.
Row 2: Aris, dark hair with a narrow silver streak, glasses visible in slight profile, white lab coat, teal shirt, charcoal trousers, dark shoes; compact black mesh office chair with armrests and five caster base.
Row 3: Elena, auburn bun, glasses, olive vest over cream blouse, dark olive-grey trousers, brown shoes; compact black mesh office chair with armrests and five caster base.
Row 4: Marcus, dark tousled hair, short beard visible in slight profile, purple hoodie, charcoal trousers, brown shoes; compact black mesh office chair with armrests and five caster base.
The chair back should rise to the shoulder blades, never obscure the entire head. Believable compact human scale matching a richly detailed pixel-art building.

prompts.name: chair_prompt_plate
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean plate for small selective chair removal in an existing approved pixel-art studio.
Input image: edit target, the existing three-floor cutaway studio at sunset.
Primary request: REMOVE ONLY the EIGHT EMPTY CHAIRS/STOOLS at the eight personal desks. These are: three black mesh office chairs on the top floor; on the middle floor a tiny black chair at the left writing desk, a small round wooden stool at the centre desk, and the brown-black swivel chair in the right office; on the bottom floor the large black mesh office chair in the left media room, and the round wooden stool in the middle drawing room.
Fill the tiny removed-chair silhouettes with the correct hidden wooden desk fronts, drawer fronts, wooden floor boards, wall colours, and existing under-desk detail as a seamless clean plate. Do not remove any desk, monitor, cabinet, pot, decoration, plant, library book, lamp, beam, building wall, cushion on the sofa, dining benches, sofa or parked bicycle.
Invariants: keep EXACTLY the same image dimensions, camera, composition, building geometry, all three floors, sky, city, lighting, warm colours and detailed pixel-art style. No people, no replacement chairs. Only the eight empty-chair silhouettes change. Do not redesign or re-render other details.
